product_one_liner.value: SalesMail provides personalized video outreach and on-site tour intelligence for sales teams in senior living, home care, and related relationship-driven industries.
product_one_liner.notes: The official homepage says SalesMail provides personalized video and on-site tour intelligence to build trust and book tours/assessments; it describes personalized video and tour intelligence as the product functions.

pricing_page.notes: The company homepage directs visitors to book a demo and has no pricing mention; G2 says the vendor does not list pricing or plans publicly. This supports no public company pricing page.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: SalesMail’s testimonial page names Asbury Communities, Sinceri Senior Living, Grand Living and Otterbein SeniorLife as users giving testimonials. | named_customers.0: The testimonial identifies Nina Butler at Asbury Communities. | named_customers.1: The testimonial identifies Jackie Johnson at Sinceri Senior Living. | named_customers.2: The testimonial identifies Eric Varin at Grand Living. | named_customers.3: The testimonial page identifies Otterbein SeniorLife and provides a customer testimonial.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile reports 16 employees, which falls in the 11-20 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: HeartLegacy’s company profile gives its address in Daphne, Alabama, establishing Daphne as the headquarters city. | hq_country: HeartLegacy’s company profile gives its Daphne, Alabama address and identifies the country as the United States.

founded_year.notes: The LinkedIn company profile identifies HeartLegacy and states its founding year as 2014.

eng_blog.notes: The official blog index shows a sales-oriented promotional post about the product and newsletter marketing, not a qualifying engineering blog with at least two posts by engineers about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public SalesMail Knowledge Base lists several sections, including how-to videos, help and ideas, and Sidekick documentation, supporting the presence of public product documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current careers page lists Client Success Specialist, Product Manager and Demand Generation Specialist. None of these titles is an AI, ML or data-science role.

model_provider.value: Amazon Web Services (Amazon Transcribe) and Anthropic (Claude API)
model_provider.notes: The app privacy policy directly names Amazon Transcribe from Amazon Web Services for transcription and Anthropic’s Claude API for summaries, coaching, scores and related AI features.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center compliance section names SOC 2 only as in progress. The requested rule excludes in-progress certifications, leaving an empty list.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: PitchBook labels the latest financing type Debt - PPP; there is some conflicting database treatment of this PPP financing, so confidence is medium. | funding_date: The PitchBook record gives the latest debt-PPP financing date as 2020-05-01; expressed in the requested YYYY-MM format, this is 2020-05. | funding_amount_usd: PitchBook identifies HeartLegacy II LLC (also known as HeartLegacy) and reports its latest financing as a $0.208 million PPP debt financing. Other databases conflict on whether PPP debt counts as a funding round and on the amount, so this field uses the specific financing record and has medium confidence.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent financing identified by PitchBook is a PPP debt financing in May 2020, well before the 18-month window ending November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The official Sales Executive posting remains available with an Apply Now action, and it identifies the role as Sales, so it is an active account-executive-type sales opening.

launched_6mo.notes: SalesMail’s official announcement dated September 16, 2026 states that the company launched Sidekick, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The current official leadership page lists six leaders. The LinkedIn profile gives the COO’s SalesMail start date as 2025-11-01, eight days before the specified 12-month window began on 2025-11-09; no qualifying C-level/VP join or departure in the window was found. Absence of a departure announcement carries some uncertainty.
